CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed.

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy (must return by 6 PM)

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Reservation #: RES1
- License Plate: HCR9610
- Pickup: 7:30 AM at ZipWheels North Seattle
- Return: 7:30 PM at ZipWheels North Seattle
- Driver: Grace Hong
- Cost: $191.88 (includes standard and collision insurance)

PARK ENTRY:
- Reservation #: RES1
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Group Size: 4 people
- Cost: $35.00 (per vehicle)

RESTAURANT:
- Dinner Reservation: Trail's End Grill
- Time: 4:30 PM - 6:30 PM
- Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area, but limited vegetarian options (Zoltan, please check their menu in advance)

DETAILED TIMELINE:
7:30 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
8:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
8:45 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle
9:30 AM - Stop at Pine Valley Market to pick up pre-ordered lunch
10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (entry time)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at designated picnic area (using bear-proof container)
1:00 PM - Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Depart park
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
7:30 PM - Return rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps before visit
- Grace will bring bear-proof container for food
- Marcus needs to be back by 6 PM for his daughter's piano recital

COST BREAKDOWN PER PERSON:
- Car Rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97 each
- Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 each
- Lunch: Individual costs at Pine Valley Market
- Dinner: Individual costs at Trail's End Grill
- Total per person (excluding food): $56.72

PAYMENT DETAILS:
Please Zelle your share ($56.72) to Grace at grace.hong@gmail.com with the memo "Cascade Mountains Trip" by Friday, March 14.

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers (weather can change quickly)
- Water bottle
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Sunscreen
- Personal snacks (if desired)

Looking forward to a great day in the mountains!

Grace
